agent.unexpected_context_overflow: record failure; no hidden changes to truncation or budget
accepted_action_formats: one Qwen XML bash/command tool call

source_workspace_exclusions.ljharb/qs: Omit dist bundle, an unmodified duplicate of target source, from agent/grader snapshots

failure_policy: Preserve controller failures. Recovery only at completed-step boundaries with unchanged artifacts and original deadline. Never rerun a scored task or tune after scoring.
primary: Paired fresh repository success, with all24historical tasks and three known regressions as preregistered safety gates; source progress is secondary and not a success substitute.

factor_definitions.progress: Only temporary answer-free system reminder from observed editable-file bytes, completed calls and repeated executed commands; generic rule locked in intervention.json before fresh source inspection. Same model/tools/parser/history/budgets.

ordering: All24historical then12fresh, original frozen order. Alternate first arm per task index. One backend, no cross-request cache. Always finish both stages; no policy tuning between stages.

exposure.historical: All24observed in016; three regressed private trajectories inspected to design rule. No training or teacher API.
exposure.fresh: Blinker and p-map previously unused in this project; six constructed defects each. Policy locked before their source inspection. Tests visible; pretraining exposure unknown. Independent repositories, not independent authors/organizations or real issue resolution.

promotion.meaning: Candidate for further independent replication only; not deployment or advanced-coding certification.
